exposure: Cascade of care in HIV prevention
outcome: Mother-to-child HIV transmission (proxy: AIDS detection rate in children under 5 years)
Rates of women receiving ART during prenatal care
cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant women in Amazonas, Ceara, Espirito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, and the Distrito Federal, Brazil, and their children under 5 years, identified through the Brazilian Information System on Diseases of Notification (SINAN).
finding: The study identified flaws at all points in the cascade of HIV care for pregnant women, with fewer than 90% receiving antiretroviral therapy during prenatal care, despite an overall reduction in AIDS detection in children under 5 years from 2007 to 2012.
mod_finding: The elective cesarean rate was low.
